lines.say: Five things nobody tells you about Pulsebox. Number five isn't even out yet.
lines.cap: 5 things nobody tells you about PULSEBOX. #5 isn't even out yet.

lines.say: One. Your progress follows you. Start on a laptop, finish on your phone.
lines.cap: #1. Your progress follows you. Start on a laptop, finish on your phone.

lines.say: Two. Make a room, share a four letter code, and play with your friends.
lines.cap: #2. Make a room, share a 4-letter code, and play with your friends.

lines.say: Three. Your name and your level go on the leaderboard.
lines.cap: #3. Your name and your level go on the leaderboard.

lines.say: Four. The Games of the Day sit right at the top, so you always know what to play.
lines.cap: #4. The Games of the Day sit right at the top, so you always know what to play.

lines.say: And five. Elite games are coming. Invite three friends, and they're yours for good.
lines.cap: And #5. Elite games are coming. Invite 3 friends, and they're yours for good.

lines.say: Seventy-seven free games, nothing to download. Box dot pulseform dot org.
lines.cap: 77 free games, nothing to download. box.pulseform.org
